checks.method_note: Brightness is regressed on DEM gradients. scripts/photometric_control.py shows the method is unbiased (<= 0.03 m) on synthetic images rendered from the DTM, with and without cast shadows, and a direct image-vs-rendering cross-correlation gives the same ~2.4 m offset; the offset is therefore treated as a real DTM-to-orthoimage displacement (USGS FGDC: orthoimage co-registration up to 3 m at the 99th percentile). Albedo variation is not modelled. Routing uses only the DTM; the offset affects overlay display.
